name: Swan Hill
terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

blurb.text: A region spanning the Murray River in Victoria and New South Wales, with almost all vineyards irrigated from the river. Its fruity Shiraz and Chardonnay are generally best drunk within about two years of vintage.
